date_note: Date of the ACN alert; updated 20 November to add two CVEs.
title: Italy's CSIRT: Mitel MiCollab updates fix 5 flaws, two rated critical
products: MiCollab Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV)
summary: Italy's national CSIRT (ACN) says Mitel security updates fix 5 vulnerabilities in MiCollab, two of them critical. It lists an XML injection (CVE-2026-133303, CVSS v3.1 9) and a command injection (CVE-2026-133323, CVSS v3.1 10), both by an unauthenticated remote attacker. Affected: MiCollab 10.3.0.18 without the patch in KB000129195, and earlier. The alert marks exploitation and public exploit code as '-' for both critical flaws.
plain: Mitel fixed five flaws in its MiCollab conferencing software, two of them critical. Italy's CSIRT lists a maximum-score one that an unauthenticated remote attacker could use.
exec: Two critical MiCollab flaws could be used by unauthenticated remote attackers; Italy's CSIRT lists no exploitation.
action: Apply the patch in Mitel KB000129195 (advisory MISA-2026-0012) to MiCollab 10.3.0.18 and earlier, starting with internet-facing systems.

recommendations: Apply the patch in KB000129195 per advisory MISA-2026-0012.

validation.note: Read the ACN alert only; Mitel's own advisory MISA-2026-0012 was not read.
